purpose: Source-level provenance and rights-review registry for ARIA knowledge ingestion. This is an operational checklist, not legal advice or a substitute for checking current source terms.

wikipedia.license_summary: CC BY-SA and GFDL may apply; verify the exact dump and applicable terms.
wikipedia.notes: Preserve attribution and license notices; check share-alike requirements for derivative content.

wikidata.license_summary: Structured data is generally CC0; verify the exact dump and any non-data content terms.
wikidata.notes: Record dump version/date and confirm terms for the downloaded artifact.

stackexchange.license_summary: Content licensing can vary by post date and applicable terms; commonly CC BY-SA. Preserve post-level attribution.
stackexchange.notes: Keep canonical post links and author attribution where supplied; verify applicable license version.

openstax.license_summary: License varies by textbook and component; some works may have non-commercial restrictions.
openstax.notes: Do not assume one license covers all books, figures, or third-party content.

pubmed.license_summary: Citation metadata and abstracts may have different rights; publisher full text is not automatically open licensed.
pubmed.notes: Do not treat PubMed indexing as permission to redistribute article full text.

gutenberg.license_summary: Public-domain status varies by work and jurisdiction; Project Gutenberg trademark and license notices may apply.
gutenberg.notes: Verify each work's status in the intended jurisdiction and preserve required notices.

openalex.license_summary: Check current OpenAlex terms and field-level rights; abstracts may originate from third parties.
openalex.notes: Do not assume that access to metadata grants redistribution rights to every abstract.

codingdocs.license_summary: License and attribution requirements vary by documentation project and version.
codingdocs.notes: Preserve per-project license files and version/canonical URL; third-party assets may have separate terms.
